experiment_data.hypothesis: σ=0.1 tests the lower bound of effective TCN noise; if Walker σ=0.2 prevents CIVO and σ=0.1 does not, establishes minimum effective dose. Same CIVO-inducing config (gate_fixed_dt=2, subsample_max_dt=2, imag_horizon=8). Three-point dose-response: σ=0.1 (this), σ=0.2 (success), σ=0.5 (oscillatory failure).
